textboxQuestion3.text: The survey was longer than I expected. Additionally, not being able to use my cursor to delete specific typos was fairly frustrating. Laslty, my main complaint, was that the emails were often context dependent. If an email "looked real," but was asking for a password reset; I would've known whether or not I requested a password reset (for example). A specific example was the Barclays one, if I was actually locked out of my account or not would've heavily influenced my willingness to believe the email was legitmate or not.
